name: HR Policy Agent — Fast Smoke Evaluation Dataset
description: Fast 4-case smoke subset for rapid regression checking during developer iterations.

parts.text: How many days of paid outpatient sick leave do I get per year, and what is the deadline to submit a Medical Certificate if I'm out sick for 3 days?
Up to 14 days paid outpatient sick leave per calendar year at 100% of base salary. If sick more than two work days, a Medical Certificate must be submitted (via WorkWeek) within 48 hours.
I'm staying at my cousin's house on a work trip instead of a hotel. As a thank-you I want to buy him a $45 gift card and expense it. Is that allowed?

Host gifts up to US$50/day are allowed WITH receipts, BUT cash and gift cards are prohibited as host gifts (and as business courtesies) regardless of amount. Therefore a $45 gift card is NOT allowed — the $50/day limit is irrelevant because gift cards are a prohibited category.

criteria.gotcha: A value under a spending limit does not make a prohibited category allowed.

parts.text: My golden retriever passed away this morning after 12 years with our family. How many days of paid bereavement leave can I log in WorkWeek?

Paid bereavement leave is up to 4 weeks (20 work days) for close loved ones or pregnancy loss. However, Section 3.1 explicitly states: 'Paid bereavement leave does not apply to pet loss.' The employee is entitled to 0 days of paid bereavement leave and must use vacation, unpaid time off, or flexible schedules instead.

criteria.gotcha: Semantic keyword match returns 4 weeks for human loved ones, but pet loss is explicitly excluded from paid bereavement leave.

parts.text: What is Altostrat's reimbursement policy for adopting a pet?
The handbook has no pet-adoption reimbursement policy. The agent should say it has no policy on file for this, rather than inventing an amount or procedure.
